Both abilities are now implemented. "Whenever you play a card from hand, you may put a card from hand FACE DOWN into your arsenal" had been removed: it was authored as PUT_CARDS_BOTTOM, which bottom-decks the whole hand and reads none of amount/face_down/destination, so it would have destroyed the player's hand on every card played. PUT_INTO_ARSENAL now takes from:"HAND" (the player chooses which card, unlike the deck-top form where the card is determined) and ON_CARD_PLAYED already dispatches to the hero.

"Whenever a TRAP you control TRIGGERS, deal 1 damage to the attacking hero" was on ON_TRAP_TRIGGER, which was not a trigger name. CR 8.2.7 retired trap as a functional subtype, so there is no trap machinery to hang it on: a trap is an ordinary card carrying the Trap subtype, and "triggers" means one of its abilities RESOLVES. The event is now dispatched from interpreter._run_ability past every gate, so a trap whose condition failed does not count.

The damage target is the OPPONENT: Riptide's traps are Defense Reactions, so a trap triggering means Riptide is defending and the attacking hero is the opponent. Stated because 'the attacking hero' and 'the opponent' coincide here but are not the same idea.
